r-books.title: The Data Warehouse Toolkit
r-books.author: Ralph Kimball & Margy Ross
r-books.why: The Bible for dimensional modeling. Read chapters 1-3 + your industry chapter.

r-books.title: Fundamentals of Data Engineering
r-books.author: Joe Reis & Matt Housley
r-books.why: Modern overview of the DE lifecycle. Read cover to cover for orientation.

r-books.title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
r-books.author: Martin Kleppmann
r-books.why: Distributed systems deep dive. Skim chapters 1-4 + 10 for AE; full read for DE.

r-books.title: SQL Antipatterns
r-books.author: Bill Karwin
r-books.why: 200 pages of "don't do this." Inoculates you against common bugs.

r-books.title: Star Schema: The Complete Reference
r-books.author: Christopher Adamson
r-books.why: Companion to Kimball — more practical examples, faster reading.

r-books.title: Streaming Systems
r-books.author: Tyler Akidau et al.
r-books.why: The reference on event-time, watermarks, exactly-once. Read once you touch streaming.

r-books.title: High Performance Spark
r-books.author: Holden Karau & Rachel Warren
r-books.why: Practical Spark tuning. Read alongside the Spark module.

r-books.title: The DataOps Cookbook
r-books.author: Christopher Bergh et al.
r-books.why: Process patterns for treating analytics like software. Skimmable.

r-books.title: 97 Things Every Data Engineer Should Know
r-books.author: Tobias Macey (ed.)
r-books.why: Short essays. Good for breakfast reading. Mixed quality.

r-books.title: Learning SQL
r-books.author: Alan Beaulieu
r-books.why: If your SQL foundation feels shaky. Skip if you're already comfortable with windows.

r-courses.title: dbt Learn — Fundamentals
r-courses.author: dbt Labs (free)
r-courses.why: Official, gold-standard, ~6 hours. Do this first if you're new to dbt.

r-courses.title: dbt Learn — Advanced Materializations
r-courses.author: dbt Labs
r-courses.why: Incremental, snapshots, contracts. Critical for production dbt.

r-courses.title: dbt Learn — Jinja, Macros, Packages
r-courses.author: dbt Labs
r-courses.why: Once you're writing macros. Required for DRY codebases.

r-courses.title: StrataScratch SQL Bootcamp
r-courses.author: StrataScratch
r-courses.why: Real interview SQL problems. Best paid resource for SQL interview prep.

r-courses.title: Mode Analytics SQL Tutorial
r-courses.author: Mode (free)
r-courses.why: Free, comprehensive, includes window functions. Good warm-up.

r-courses.title: Udacity Data Engineer Nanodegree
r-courses.author: Udacity ($)
r-courses.why: Project-driven; good if you need external structure. Pricey.

r-courses.title: Confluent Kafka Tutorial
r-courses.author: Confluent (free)
r-courses.why: When you're ready to deeply understand Kafka. Hands-on.

r-courses.title: Maven Analytics — Data Modeling
r-courses.author: Maven ($)
r-courses.why: Practical Kimball walkthrough if Kimball's book feels heavy.

r-blogs.title: Locally Optimistic
r-blogs.author: AE practitioner collective
r-blogs.why: AEs writing about real production problems. Searchable archive.

r-blogs.title: Data Engineering Weekly
r-blogs.author: Ananth Packkildurai
r-blogs.why: The best Sunday digest. ~10 min weekly read.

r-blogs.title: dbt Labs Engineering Blog
r-blogs.author: dbt Labs
r-blogs.why: Updates on dbt features and patterns. Practical not theoretical.

r-blogs.title: Databricks Blog
r-blogs.author: Databricks
r-blogs.why: Filter for "engineering" and "patterns." Marketing content is noise.

r-blogs.title: Benn.substack
r-blogs.author: Benn Stancil
r-blogs.why: Industry strategy + the metric layer wars. Good for sense-making.

r-blogs.title: Towards Data Science
r-blogs.author: Medium pub
r-blogs.why: Mixed quality. Cherry-pick by author after a few reads.

r-blogs.title: Maxime Beauchemin's Medium
r-blogs.author: Maxime Beauchemin
r-blogs.why: Founder of Airflow + Superset. His "Functional Data Engineering" essay is a must.

r-blogs.title: Recurse SQL
r-blogs.author: Various
r-blogs.why: Weekly SQL puzzles. Good for keeping skills sharp.

r-blogs.title: High Growth Engineer
r-blogs.author: Jordan Cutler
r-blogs.why: Engineering-career-arc content. Not data-specific but applicable.

r-yt.title: Coalesce (annual dbt conference)
r-yt.author: dbt Labs
r-yt.why: Annual conference talks. Real production stories. Watch the talks tagged "case study."

r-yt.title: Databricks Data + AI Summit
r-yt.author: Databricks
r-yt.why: Annual. Watch "performance" and "architecture" tracks for tuning intuition.

r-yt.title: Seattle Data Guy
r-yt.author: Ben Rogojan
r-yt.why: Practical interview prep + DE career content. ~10 min videos.

r-yt.title: Joe Reis (autodidacts)
r-yt.author: Joe Reis
r-yt.why: Author of Fundamentals of Data Engineering. Industry-wide perspective.

r-yt.title: Mehdi Ouazza (mehdio DataTV)
r-yt.author: Mehdi Ouazza
r-yt.why: Modern data stack walkthroughs. French accent ✨.

r-yt.title: Karpov.courses
r-yt.author: Karpov
r-yt.why: Russian channel, English subs. Solid SQL and warehousing tutorials.

r-yt.title: Andreas Kretz
r-yt.author: Andreas Kretz
r-yt.why: Engineering-track Data Engineer content. Heavy Kafka/Spark.

r-yt.title: Data with Zach
r-yt.author: Zach Wilson
r-yt.why: Hot takes + career advice. Skim for signal.

r-pods.title: Analytics Engineering Podcast
r-pods.author: Tristan Handy
r-pods.why: The AE category-defining conversations. ~45 min episodes.

r-pods.title: Data Engineering Podcast
r-pods.author: Tobias Macey
r-pods.why: Deep technical interviews. Longer (~1hr) but high-density.

r-pods.title: The Sequel Show
r-pods.author: Mikkel Dengsøe + Petr Janda
r-pods.why: Modern data stack culture + operational topics.

r-pods.title: Data Brew by Databricks
r-pods.author: Databricks
r-pods.why: Heavily Databricks-flavoured but good Spark internals episodes.

r-pods.title: Catalog & Cocktails
r-pods.author: Tim Gasper + Juan Sequeda
r-pods.why: Metadata, catalogs, governance — the unsexy critical stuff.

r-certs.title: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate
r-certs.author: Databricks
r-certs.why: Free study material + nominal $200 exam. Signals capability + forces structured study.

r-certs.title: dbt Analytics Engineering Certification
r-certs.author: dbt Labs
r-certs.why: $200 exam. Aligned exactly with the AE role. Renewed yearly.

r-certs.title: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional
r-certs.author: Databricks
r-certs.why: After Associate. Tests deeper Spark + Delta + production patterns.

r-certs.title: AWS Certified Data Analytics — Specialty
r-certs.author: AWS
r-certs.why: Useful if your stack is on AWS. Otherwise skip.

r-certs.title: GCP Professional Data Engineer
r-certs.author: Google Cloud
r-certs.why: Useful if on GCP. Snowflake/Databricks certs are higher leverage.

r-certs.title: Snowflake SnowPro Core
r-certs.author: Snowflake
r-certs.why: Only if your future role uses Snowflake. Skip if Databricks-bound.

r-certs.title: Confluent Certified Developer for Apache Kafka
r-certs.author: Confluent
r-certs.why: Worth it if you'll own streaming pipelines.

r-tools.title: DBeaver
r-tools.author: Open source
r-tools.why: Free SQL IDE. Connects to Databricks, Postgres, MySQL — works everywhere.

r-tools.title: dbt-core CLI
r-tools.author: dbt Labs (free)
r-tools.why: The terminal tool. Install via pip. Foundation of everything dbt.

r-tools.title: sqlfluff
r-tools.author: Open source
r-tools.why: SQL linter. Make CI fail on style violations. Configure once, save reviews forever.

r-tools.title: Databricks CLI
r-tools.author: Databricks
r-tools.why: Talk to your workspace from the terminal. Deploy dashboards, manage jobs.

r-tools.title: Elementary
r-tools.author: Elementary Data
r-tools.why: Open-source data observability for dbt. Anomaly detection + Slack alerts.

r-tools.title: dbt-codegen
r-tools.author: dbt Labs
r-tools.why: Auto-generate model yml from warehouse schemas. Saves hours.

r-tools.title: dbt-utils
r-tools.author: dbt Labs
r-tools.why: ~50 extra macros and tests. Treat as part of dbt core.

r-tools.title: dbt-expectations
r-tools.author: Calogica
r-tools.why: Great Expectations-style assertions for dbt. ~100 extra tests.

r-tools.title: pre-commit
r-tools.author: Open source
r-tools.why: Hooks for sqlfluff, ruff, black, yaml-lint. Catches mistakes before push.

r-tools.title: pytest
r-tools.author: Open source
r-tools.why: Standard for Python tests. Use for custom dbt macros, ingestion scripts.
